svg.title: Green Curve I
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study after an inspected primary museum photograph. Geometry approximate; interpretive screen colour not calibrated. Painted white upper-left area retained inside the parallelogram. Only surrounding wall is transparent; curved boundary is approximate. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of green; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
